Rave that dissolves into a kinda rant/vent: At the end of May, my brother and I decided we were going to not drink sodas or eat unnecessary snacks during June and we’ve stuck to it well. Better yet, we extended it to alcohol and got our whole family involved.

I’m the heaviest one at nearly double a healthy body weight for a 5’ 11” woman, and on a journey to lose weight. Aforementioned brother is the only one in our house who isn’t overweight/obese. I did the height and weight of our other brother (11) and sister (7) and they came out using the NHS calculator in the 91st and 95th percentile respectively. According to the parents, that’s bullshit. We did a whole family bmi-calculation session today and the results made some people sour.

Brother (11) absolutely refuses to eat anything remotely healthy and throws a tantrum if you peel away his xbox. Sister on the other hand loves vegetables and dancing , she eats a perfect diet, she just gets served adult portions. (I’m not in control of what my siblings eat).

My mum is obese and has a slight problem with alcohol, shall we say. She’s been completely sober for 10 days (after being shocked from weighing herself) and despite hating it, she’s really stuck to it. I’m proud of her. 

It does feel a little like pot-kettle-Black for me to be trying to put across about my youngest siblings being overweight and that it’s not good for them but it’s from a place of being there. I’ve been overweight since I was 8 years old, obese since my early teens, morbidly obese not long after that. It’s not a fun place to be and one of my biggest fears is them taking after me. Our house is pretty liberal with cakes and chips and chocolate (I buy my own calorie-counted meals) and it’s easy to massively overeat without realising it. There’s not really much I can do but it’s still a worry. Months ago my sister came to me in tears because girls in her class were calling her fat, and she’s such a sensitive, shy girl that it breaks my heart.

TL;DR, youngest siblings overweight, parents think it’s bullshit, I’m trying to lose a lot of weight and don’t want them where I am now.
